title: Game Jam using Antigravity!
author: Shuffle4
selftext:
May I present Bobs Ball Brawl!

This is a Beat em Up style game that plays itself!  
The characters are in an endless brawl and players can interact with a plinko board setup for upgrades to their character.  
  
The idea is you can set it up to a live stream to allow commenters to interact with the game. I was tired of seeing low quality Roblox slop populate the Youtube live short form section. Hopefully this is a little bit better!

Tools -   
Pixel Lab for the sprite generation  
Antigravity as Primary IDE
